# LARC @ Cardozo Law

> Open-access institutional repository of legal scholarship, journals, and research from Yeshiva University's Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law.

LARC (Legal Archive Research Collection) serves as Cardozo Law's digital repository for faculty and student scholarship, law journals, institutional collections, and research spanning specialized centers and institutes. The platform provides open access to 50+ years of legal scholarship across antitrust, immigration, entertainment, human rights, and corporate governance law.

## Explore Collections

- [Browse by Collection](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/communities.html): Browse and explore Cardozo Law institutional collections and publication archives
- [Faculty Scholarship](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/faculty): Cardozo Law faculty scholarship and academic publications collection
- [Student Scholarship](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/students-alums): Student articles and journals including Arts & Entertainment and Comparative Law reviews
- [Cardozo Law Journals](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/journals): Cardozo Law Review and student-run journals directory and archive
- [Cardozo Law Collections](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/cardozo_law_collections): Cardozo Law institutional archives and 50-year historical digital collections
- [Browse by Author](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/authors.html): Browse Cardozo Law scholarship by author directory and legal researcher profiles

## Featured Research

- [Most Popular Papers](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/topdownloads.html): Most downloaded legal research papers spanning antitrust, immigration, and esports law
- [Most Recent Additions](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/recent_additions.html): Recently added legal scholarship in international, energy, privacy, and sports law
- [Centers and Institutes](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/ciip): Directory of Cardozo Law centers and institutes including Perlmutter Center and FAME

## About LARC

- [Home](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu): Open-access repository of Cardozo Law scholarship, research, and institutional collections
- [About LARC](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/about.html): Information about LARC institutional repository mission and Chutick Law Library
- [Activity by Year](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/activity.html): Repository statistics and annual activity tracking for institutional scholarship

## Submit & Manage

- [Submit Your Research](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/submit_research.html): Submission guidelines for contributing research to LARC institutional repository
- [User Account Login](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/cgi/myaccount.cgi): User authentication and account login for LARC repository access

## Help & Support

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/faq.html): FAQ covering repository submission, document formatting, and file management
- [Email Notifications and RSS](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/announcements.html): Email alerts and RSS feed subscriptions for LARC content updates

## Optional

- [Accessibility Statement](https://larc.cardozo.yu.edu/accessibility.html): WCAG 2.1 and Section 508 accessibility compliance documentation
